notes.en: **For weapons/artifacts that require [[character:mitya]] to trigger an elemental reaction:** [[character:mitya]] is only able to consistently do this if there is a larger amount of [[element:cryo]] application than [[element:electro]] application.

[[character:mitya]] is an Off-Field DPS through his tap [[ability:skill]] that deals damage and buffs the [[element:stellar-conduct]] Base DMG and [[stat:em]] of all party members. His damage comes from his [[ability:skill]], which continuously deals [[element:stellar-conduct]] damage when [[character:mitya]] gains stacks above the maximum limit (four at C0, five at C1+). Stacks are gained through triggering [[element:stellar-conduct]] and using [[character:mitya]]'s [[ability:burst]]. Using [[character:mitya]]'s [[ability:burst]] can be optional depending on the specific team he is used in.

content.en: [[character:mitya]] can perform an enhanced [[ability:ca]] to deal damage before utilizing a skill-switch to revert to his Off-Field mode. This is typically utilized in [[element:cryo]] [[character:traveler]] DPS teams.

[[character:mitya]] can swap from his offensive, on-field hold [[ability:skill]] to his supportive off-field tap [[ability:skill]] variant by using the [[ability:skill]] input within 6s of initially casting his [[ability:skill]]. This can be used as an advanced trick to use [[character:mitya]] as a Quickswap DPS.
